.subckt fable5_2_bandgap_pin_2 gnda vdda vref iref
* Banba-style current-mode bandgap, cascoded PMOS mirror array (source: claude-fable-5,
* dts21 princeton run 20260717-185516). Composite resistors (two series legs with opposite
* tc1/tc2) cancel TC. All cascode gates tie to "vref", which is itself generated by a
* diode-connected cascode leg (drain=gate) fed off the same mirror -- vref therefore serves
* as bias, output voltage, and cascode reference simultaneously. iref is a separate cascoded
* mirror-output branch (xmco/xmpo). Startup: xmps/xmns/xmsu kick vbp low if na stays at 0V.
xmpa vma vbp vdda vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P1_L' w='P1_W*1' m='P1_M'
xmca na vref vma vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P2_L' w='P2_W*1' m='P2_M'
xmpb vmb vbp vdda vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P3_L' w='P3_W*1' m='P3_M'
xmcb nb vref vmb vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P4_L' w='P4_W*1' m='P4_M'
xmpr vmr vbp vdda vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P5_L' w='P5_W*1' m='P5_M'
xmcr vref vref vmr vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P6_L' w='P6_W*1' m='P6_M'
xmpo vmo vbp vdda vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P7_L' w='P7_W*1' m='P7_M'
xmco iref vref vmo vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P8_L' w='P8_W*1' m='P8_M'
xmld nd nd vdda vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P9_L' w='P9_W*1' m='P9_M'
xmlo vbp nd vdda vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P10_L' w='P10_W*1' m='P10_M'
xmpt vmt vbp vdda vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P11_L' w='P11_W*1' m='P11_M'
xmps s gnda vdda vdda sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l='P12_L' w='P12_W*1' m='P12_M'
xmib nd nb tail gnda sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l='N1_L' w='N1_W*1' m='N1_M'
xmia vbp na tail gnda sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l='N2_L' w='N2_W*1' m='N2_M'
xmnb nbias nbias gnda gnda sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l='N3_L' w='N3_W*1' m='N3_M'
xmnt tail nbias gnda gnda sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l='N4_L' w='N4_W*1' m='N4_M'
xmns s na gnda gnda sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l='N5_L' w='N5_W*1' m='N5_M'
xmsu vbp s gnda gnda sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l='N6_L' w='N6_W*1' m='N6_M'
xq1 gnda gnda na sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W3p40L3p40 m='Q1_M'
xq8 gnda gnda e8 sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W3p40L3p40 m='Q2_M'
CV vref gnda 'CAPACITOR_1'
CC vbp vdda 'CAPACITOR_2'
RH2A na x2a 'RESISTOR_1' tc1=0.514e-3 tc2=0.122e-5
RX2A x2a gnda 'RESISTOR_2' tc1=-1.47e-3 tc2=2.7e-6
RH1 nb x1 'RESISTOR_3' tc1=0.514e-3 tc2=0.122e-5
RX1 x1 e8 'RESISTOR_4' tc1=-1.47e-3 tc2=2.7e-6
RH2B nb x2b 'RESISTOR_5' tc1=0.514e-3 tc2=0.122e-5
RX2B x2b gnda 'RESISTOR_6' tc1=-1.47e-3 tc2=2.7e-6
RH3 vref x3 'RESISTOR_7' tc1=0.514e-3 tc2=0.122e-5
RX3 x3 gnda 'RESISTOR_8' tc1=-1.47e-3 tc2=2.7e-6
RNB vmt nbias 'RESISTOR_9'
.ends fable5_2_bandgap_pin_2
